summary: Authors may use generative AI when preparing manuscripts but remain fully responsible for accuracy, and submission implies they reviewed and edited any AI-generated content. Members of the review team (reviewers, Associate Editors, Department Editors) must ensure conclusions are their own and must not upload any part of a manuscript into a generative AI tool in a way that could compromise confidentiality or copyright. The page does not address disclosure, AI authorship, or AI-generated images.

evidence.quote: We cannot prevent authors from using generative AI in the preparation of their manuscripts.
